info.name: JenaValve Discover AR Site API (WordPress REST) SEO API
Get Yoast SEO head metadata for a URL

items.docs: Returns the rendered `<head>` SEO metadata block (title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter card and schema.org JSON-LD) that Yoast SEO v27.2 emits for any discover-ar.com URL. Useful for retrieving structured metadata about an education library item without parsing the page.
